انحدروا (form VII)
# اِنْحَدَرُوا (inḥadarū) /in.ħa.da.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# اِنْحَدِرُوا (inḥadirū) /in.ħa.di.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
